question: Which seller state has the highest late delivery rate among seller states with at least 100 delivered orders?
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS late_delivery_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.seller_state HAVING delivered_orders >= 100 ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Among product categories with at least 500 order items, which category has the highest average freight cost as a percentage of item price?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(oi.freight_value / oi.price) * 100 AS avg_freight_pct, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE oi.price > 0 GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english HAVING item_count >= 500 ORDER BY avg_freight_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For delivered orders in 2018, which month had the highest average delivery delay in days?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_estimated_delivery_date)) AS avg_delay_days, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which payment type has the highest average payment value per transaction?
sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(payment_value) AS avg_payment_value, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY avg_payment_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which customer state has the highest cancellation rate among states with at least 100 orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state HAVING order_count >= 100 ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product category generated the highest item revenue excluding freight?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS item_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY item_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which seller has the highest late delivery rate among sellers with at least 50 delivered orders?
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS late_delivery_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING delivered_orders >= 50 ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What percentage of total payment value comes from credit card payments?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN payment_value ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(payment_value) AS credit_card_payment_share FROM order_payments;

question: Among product categories with at least 300 reviews, which category has the highest average review score?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english HAVING review_count >= 300 ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which customer state generated the highest delivered-order revenue including freight in 2017?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
